meta.note: shadcn-vue (Tailwind v4) tokens from ADR 00009 on the olive base color (Tailwind v4.2 olive scale), with an olive green brand color on `primary`, `ring` and `accent`, a blue `success`, and `input` and `muted-foreground` adjusted for WCAG 2.2 AA. Breakpoints are the Tailwind v4 defaults.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (`bg-background`). White in light, olive-950 in dark. Also the fill of outline buttons and dialogs.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted`. Olive-950 / olive-50. 19.6:1 light, 16.4:1 dark on card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Fill of `Card` (restaurants and reviews in lists) and of the destructive `Alert`. White in light, olive-900 in dark.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Fill of floating surfaces: the `Select` list.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The olive green brand color. The one main action per view (default `Button`, default `Badge`), links, selected `RatingInput` segments and filled `RatingDisplay` pips. As a mark: 5.8:1 on `background` in light, 10.1:1 in dark. Light green with dark text in the dark theme.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`: olive-50 on green in light (5.6:1), olive-900 on light green in dark (8.7:1). Never white in dark.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary `Button` and `Badge` fill, olive-100 / olive-800. Too close to `background` to mark a boundary on its own.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`. 15.4:1 light, 13.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: empty `RatingDisplay` pips. Olive-100 / olive-800.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Help text, descriptions, metadata (creator, dates). Light: 5.3:1 on `background` and `card`, 4.8:1 on `muted`. Dark (olive-400): 8.4:1 on `background`, 7.3:1 on `card`, 6.1:1 on `muted`. Light is darker than olive-500, which gives only 4.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Green tint. Hover fill of ghost and outline buttons and `Select` items; `Skeleton` fill.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`: deep olive green in light (7.2:1), pale green in dark (9.4:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete actions, API errors, invalid field borders and `FormMessage` text. The shadcn red, unchanged by the base color. As text: 4.8:1 light, 6.8:1 / 5.9:1 dark on background / card. Always paired with a word or icon, never color alone. Red sits on the other side of the hue wheel from the green brand, but the two are only 1.2:1 apart in lightness in light. People with red-green color blindness can mistake one for the other, so delete buttons always say "Delete" and live in a confirming `Dialog`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations: success `Toast` and success `Alert` icon and title, such as "Review saved". Blue, not green, so it never reads as the brand color or as the opposite of `destructive` red to people with red-green color blindness. As text: 6.5:1 on `background`, 5.9:1 on `muted` in light; 8.9:1 on `background`, 7.7:1 on `card` in dark. Always paired with an icon and words.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `success` fill: 6.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, dialog, alert and table hairlines. Olive-200 in light; white at 10% in dark. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `TagInput` and unselected `RatingInput` segments. Light: 3.5:1 on `background` and `card`, 3.2:1 on `muted`. Dark is white at 16%: 4.0:1 on `background`, 3.6:1 on `card`, 3.1:1 on `muted`. Meets the 3:1 control-boundary floor (WCAG 1.4.11). Keep `border` for decorative hairlines.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline of every interactive component (ADR 00009), a solid 2px olive green outline with a 2px offset, never at /50 as stock shadcn does. Same value as `primary`. Light: 5.8:1 on `background`, 5.3:1 on `muted`. Dark: 8.7:1 on `card`, 7.4:1 on `muted`. Meets the 3:1 floor for focus indicators.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, one per screen (`text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight`).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title on a screen (`text-3xl font-semibold`).

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Group title inside a form or card (`text-xl font-semibold`).

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro line under a page title, in `muted-foreground` (`text-xl`).

styles.name: large
styles.usage: Emphasised values, such as an overall score (`text-lg font-semibold`).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Long text: review feedback, restaurant description (`leading-7`).

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, labels, inputs on md+ screens (`text-sm font-medium`).

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding (`py-0.5`).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Select list padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap inside card headers and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label, its field and its message (`gap-2`); button gap; dialog footer gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding (`px-3`); alert vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding (`px-4`), alert horizontal padding, dialog content gap, gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between card parts (`px-6 py-6 gap-6`); dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Select items, small chips inside TagInput (`--radius` minus 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, badges, tab triggers, skeletons (`--radius` minus 2px).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base `--radius` (0.625rem). Dialogs and alerts (`rounded-lg`).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards (`rounded-xl`, `--radius` plus 4px).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons (outline), inputs, selects.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, the active tab.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The open Select list.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

breakpoint.note: Tailwind v4 default breakpoints. Layout is mobile first: style the small screen, then add `sm:`, `md:` and up.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: `sm:`. Two-column forms start here.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: `md:`. Inputs drop from 16px to 14px text. The header shows full navigation instead of the menu button.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: `lg:`. Restaurant lists show two cards per row.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: `xl:`. Restaurant lists show three cards per row.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: `2xl:`. No layout change; content stays at `content-max`.

size.note: Page widths. Center the content column with `mx-auto` and pad it with `px-4` (16px), `sm:px-6` (24px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Width of the page column and the header content (`max-w-6xl`): lists of restaurants and reviews.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Width of forms, sign in and long review text (`max-w-2xl`). Keeps lines near 70 characters.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of `AppHeader` (`h-16`).

zIndex.note: Stacking order, low to high. Use only these values.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky `AppHeader` (`z-40`). Content scrolls under it.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: `Select` lists, the `UserMenu` and `ThemeToggle` menus, the `Dialog` overlay and panel (`z-50`, shadcn-vue default).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: `Toast` messages (`z-[100]`). They stay above an open dialog.
